topDecks.name: Amber/Emerald Dogs
topDecks.description: The deck to beat. Won DLC Ghent (both brackets), placed 22 copies in top cut. Winterspell additions Grandmother Willow and Nani - Stage Manager turbocharge the already fast game plan. Under the Sea enables explosive cost reduction turns.
topDecks.gameplan: Flood board turns 1-3 with cheap dogs. Use Grandmother Willow to dump hand and cheat Tramp - Street-Smart Dog on turn 3. Generate lore with Tramp synergies, use Under the Sea to close with a singer discount. Lady - Miss Park Avenue and Emerald Chromicon refuel, Ursula/Mowgli strip opponent answers.
strengths: Hard to interact with due to cost reduction
weaknesses: Weak to Amber/Steel (Angel - Experiment 624 hard counters)
Vulnerable to well-timed board sweeps
Amethyst/Steel has favored matchup
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Grandmother Willow, any 1-2 cost dogs, or Tramp - Enterprising Dog. Mulligan all hands without a turn-1 or turn-2 play.

topDecks.name: Amethyst/Sapphire Control
topDecks.description: Highest raw power in a vacuum. Tipo + Sail ramp into Genie - Wish Fulfilled, Dumbo, Demona, and Hades. Now features Swordplay for extra +3 challenge math vs Dogs, and Demona - Betrayer of the Clan as a 4-of for stability.
keyCards: Dumbo - Ninth Wonder of the Universe
Demona - Scourge of the Wyvern Clan
topDecks.gameplan: Turn 1-2: Ramp with Tipo/Sail. Turn 3-5: Chain Genie/Dumbo card advantage. Turn 4+: Deploy Demona for stats + stabilize. Turn 6+: Hades, Into the Unknown, and finishers close the door.
strengths: Flexible removal suite (Let it Go, Hades, Into the Unknown)
weaknesses: Slightly soft to Dogs pre-stabilization (Under the Sea takes key pieces)
Mirror match skill-intensive
Requires careful ink management
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Tipo or Sail the Azurite Sea. Any hand with a turn-2 ramp piece and a follow-up is keepable.

topDecks.name: Emerald/Sapphire Control
topDecks.description: Won DLC Taipei (Edmond Chiu). Accelerates ink, draws cards with Clarabelle, then slams haymakers. The Under the Sea + Malicious, Mean and Scary pivot vs Dogs — combined with Ink Geyser after a shifted Prince Phillip — is the key adaptation from Winterspell.
topDecks.gameplan: Turn 1-2: Ramp with Tipo/Sail. Turn 3: Clarabelle or tempo piece. Turn 4+: John Silver to deny lore then under the sea sweep. Turn 5+: Prince Phillip shifted in + Ink Geyser for full lock.
strengths: Under the Sea + Prince Phillip package beats Dogs
weaknesses: Vulnerable early if ramp is disrupted
Slightly weaker mirror into Amethyst/Sapphire
Set up turns are critical
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Tipo, Sail the Azurite Sea, or John Silver. Must have a turn-2 play.

topDecks.name: Amber/Steel
topDecks.description: Emerged at DLC Ghent as a Dogs counter and won the CCS $25k Invitational Qualifier. Two variants: Steelsong (Ariel - Ethereal Voice engine) and Goliath-focus (Goliath - Clan Leader). Angel - Experiment 624 is a hard counter to Dogs, and Akood Et Emuti enables explosive early shifts.
topDecks.gameplan: Turn 2: Angel - Experiment 624 via Akood Et Emuti / Angel - Siren Singer. Angel discards and removes cheap Dogs threats. Grandmother Willow dodges Under the Sea for key threats. Goliath counters Clarabelle; mid-game threats recoup hand with Nani/Doc.
strengths: Ignores Under the Sea via Grandmother Willow
Good threat density at multiple curve points
weaknesses: Weaker in Amethyst-heavy fields
Less resilient without Angel on board
Runs out of gas in very long games
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Angel - Siren Singer or Cinderella - Dream Come True. Ideal: Singer/Cinderella + Akood Et Emuti for turn-2 Angel.

topDecks.name: Amethyst/Steel Midrange
topDecks.description: Best positioned against aggro. Strong removal suite and consistent curve. Two sub-variants: traditional midrange and location-based aggro (Fairy Ship, Castle Wyvern). Genie - Magical Researcher and Sven - Leaping Reindeer as new Winterspell additions.
topDecks.gameplan: Curve out 1-2-3-4, use Strength of a Raging Fire to stabilize against aggro, generate value with Doc/Genie. Giant Cobra provides late reach. Genie - Magical Researcher wins slow games.
weaknesses: Loses to Amethyst/Sapphire card advantage engine
Slower to establish than Amber/Steel vs aggro
Clarabelle is hard to answer
topDecks.mulligan: Keep cheap creatures or Calhoun/Captain Hook. Ideal: 1-drop, 2-drop, removal.

topDecks.name: Sapphire/Steel
topDecks.description: Rising archetype — won a Winterspell Set Champs. Uses Tipo/Sail ramp into Doc - Bold Knight and Goliath - Clan Leader for card recovery. Jasmine - Steady Strategist (enabled by Pete - Ghost of Christmas Past) provides consistent 4-cost targets. Strength of a Raging Fire and He Hurled His Thunderbolt handle board pressure.
topDecks.gameplan: Ramp with Tipo/Sail. Turn 3: Pete or Jasmine as blocker/singer. Turn 4+: Shift Jasmine into He Hurled His Thunderbolt. Goliath counters Clarabelle. Close with Vincenzo/Tinker Bell.
weaknesses: Slightly slower than Emerald/Sapphire
Fewer answers to Dogs early curve than Amber/Steel
Less raw card advantage than Amethyst lines
topDecks.mulligan: Keep early blockers + Tipo or Sail. Ideal: Ramp piece + Pete or Jasmine.

topDecks.name: Amber/Sapphire Mufasa Control
topDecks.description: Emerging archetype that turned heads at DLC Ghent (top 16). Features Mufasa - Ruler of Pride Rock as a dominant threat alongside Ohana Means Family for burst card draw. Nakoma - Waiting Out the Storm as a resilient midgame blocker. Won a Set Champs (Princess Power! variant).
topDecks.gameplan: Midgame: Deploy Nakoma to threaten and contest anything the opponent has played. Pivot into Mufasa to dominate the board with stats. Ohana Means Family for burst draw. Scuttle/Stitch quest while Mufasa wins challenges.
strengths: Nakoma is hard to remove efficiently
Ohana Means Family generates game-winning card advantage
weaknesses: Dogs can go under it if Nakoma doesn't arrive on time
Less consistent than dedicated Sapphire ramp decks
Still being refined
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Nakoma, any early tempo piece, Hades. Ideal: Turn-3 Nakoma + follow-up plan.

topDecks.name: Amber/Ruby Boost Control
topDecks.description: Off-meta success — won a Set Champs (Black Dragon Games). Raging Storm provides no-questions-asked board reset. Works around the Dogs and Sapphire triangle with flexible removal and midrange threats. Lilo - Escape Artist and Rampking-style combo lines.
topDecks.gameplan: Control early board with Ruby tempo, deploy midrange threats, Raging Storm when behind. Close with Amber card advantage engines.
strengths: Raging Storm is a clean answer to Dogs flood
Unexpected deck — opponents rarely know the lines
weaknesses: Less powerful than top meta decks in fair fights
Inconsistent without Raging Storm
Slower tempo than dedicated aggro
topDecks.mulligan: Keep early Ruby plays + any removal. Raging Storm is the most important singleton to find.

topDecks.name: Amethyst/Emerald Hyper Aggro
topDecks.description: Won a Winterspell Set Champs. 28+ one-cost characters, closes with Enigmatic Inkcaster. Extremely fast but fragile. Amethyst Chromicon fuels refill. Mulan burn variant also active.
keyCards: The White Rose - Jewel of the Garden
topDecks.gameplan: Flood with 1-cost creatures every turn, trigger Enigmatic Inkcaster twice, close with lore generation before opponent stabilizes.
weaknesses: Destroyed by Amethyst/Steel
No plan B if Inkcaster is removed
Dogs can race it
topDecks.mulligan: Keep any 1-cost creatures, mulligan everything else.

topDecks.name: Amethyst/Ruby Control
topDecks.description: Won a Winterspell Set Champs. Diablo - Watchful Raven and Peter Pan - High Flyer provide aggressive evasive threats. Beast's Castle - Winter Gardens as a powerful new location that doubles lore and protects characters.
topDecks.gameplan: Establish Beast's Castle early, deploy evasive threats that challenge freely while generating lore. Diablo into Beast's Castle turns any challenge into free lore gains.
weaknesses: Location-heavy strategy loses to targeted removal
Slower setup than pure aggro
Weaker in no-location metas
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Beast's Castle and any 2-drop. Ideal: Location + evasive threat.

playTips: Amber/Emerald Dogs is public enemy #1 — know how to beat it or play it yourself
Emerald/Sapphire wins by mastering the Under the Sea + Malicious, Mean and Scary pivot against Dogs — don't skip that line
Amber/Steel's Angel - Experiment 624 is the hardest counter to Dogs; consider it in any Steel shell
Akood Et Emuti enables turn-2 4-drops or 3-drops; sequence your singers carefully for this effect
Grandmother Willow - Ancient Advisor enables characters to dodge Under the Sea — sequence her before key threats
Sapphire/Steel is underrated and rising — Jasmine - Steady Strategist on turn 2 via ramp is undervalued
Amethyst/Sapphire is still the most powerful deck in a vacuum but Dogs was adapted around at Taipei — the meta shifts are ongoing
Set Championship season has diversified the format — Amber/Ruby, Sapphire/Steel, and Amethyst/Ruby now all win high-level events
Hiram Flaversham - Toymaker is banned — update all Steel decks that relied on Fortisphere enabling
Set 13 is now legal in Core, and early testing suggests meaningful shifts in tempo and value mirrors before DLC Indianapolis/Dortmund

metaPairings.assessment: Even to slightly favored post-Taipei tech
metaPairings.plan: Mulligan for Tipo/Sail + John Silver. Look for Under the Sea + Malicious, Mean and Scary pivot. Ink Geyser after a shifted Prince Phillip - Vanquisher of Foes is usually a win.
Prioritize ramp leads and don't let their Demona - Betrayer of the Clan snowball. Clarabelle needs to fire before their Demona turns.
Force Angel - Experiment 624 off board early. Use Mowgli - Man Cub to strip Angel or cost pieces to prevent her landing. Grandmother Willow shrinks opponent's hand so they cannot reload Angel.
Sequence threats to bait removal before deploying Tramp - Street-Smart Dog and Under the Sea turns. Avoid wide boards into Strength of a Raging Fire.
Turn-2 Angel - Experiment 624 via Akood Et Emuti or Angel - Siren Singer. Use Angel to systematically discard and remove cheap dogs. Grandmother Willow lets key threats dodge Under the Sea.
Apply pressure before Clarabelle. Goliath - Clan Leader ruins any profitable Clarabelle activation. Dodge Under the Sea with Grandmother Willow on key threats.

Include Swordplay for +3 challenge math. Run Demona - Betrayer of the Clan as 4-of. Limit Genie - Wish Fulfilled copies to reduce Under the Sea blowout potential. Isis Vanderchill can be played to exert key bodies and buy time.
Goliath - Clan Leader is the key: deny Dogs' card advantage engine. Jasmine - Steady Strategist dodges He Hurled His Thunderbolt. Sequence removal efficiently on lore-burst threats.
Trade aggressively early and stack removal. Keep Strength of a Raging Fire for Tramp - Street-Smart Dog or wide boards. Genie - Magical Researcher wins any long game.
Race to lore 20 before their stabilization lands. Turn 5 close-out is required — if you don't win by then, you likely lose.
No good line exists against their efficient trading — consider sideboarding or a different deck for this matchup.

comboPackages.name: Ink Geyser + Prince Phillip Lock
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Shift Prince Phillip then cast Ink Geyser to deplete opponent's ink. Combined with a board sweep, this usually ends the game. The key Dogs-beating sequence confirmed at DLC Taipei.
comboPackages.counterplay: Counter by preventing Prince Phillip from shifting or keeping enough ink to respond. Some Dog lists run Mowgli to strip the Ink Geyser from hand.

comboPackages.name: Grandmother Willow Into Under the Sea
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Turn 3 Grandmother Willow dumps hand perfectly, enables consistent Turn 3 Tramp - Street-Smart Dog and finds Lilo - Escape Artist for Under the Sea. Rhino - One-Sixteenth Wolf shrinks targets into Under the Sea range.
comboPackages.counterplay: Destroy Grandmother Willow immediately. Without her the deck loses its consistency engine. Cards that discard (Mowgli, Ursula - Deceiver) can strip Under the Sea before it fires.

comboPackages.name: Akood Et Emuti Shift Engine
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Sing Akood Et Emuti on turn 2 via Cinderella or Angel - Siren Singer. Enables turn-2 Angel - Experiment 624 or turn-3 Stitch - Carefree Snowboarder. Dramatically accelerates tempo in the early game.
comboPackages.counterplay: Deny the singers before Akood Et Emuti resolves. Once Angel - Experiment 624 lands on turn 2, it is very hard to remove efficiently.

comboPackages.name: Guidebook Value Chain
cards: Dumbo - Ninth Wonder of the Universe
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Maintains card flow while deploying resilient midgame threats. Demona - Betrayer of the Clan now run as a 4-of for maximum Dogs resistance.
comboPackages.counterplay: Pressure their setup turns. Under the Sea on Genie/Dumbo is crippling. Mowgli strips Guidebook from hand.

comboPackages.name: Beast's Castle Diablo Engine
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Beast's Castle enables characters to quest AND challenge without choosing. Diablo into Beast's Castle turns any challenge into free lore. Hercules/Beast resist taking damage when challenging parked in the location.
comboPackages.counterplay: Target the location — destroy Beast's Castle and the deck loses its primary engine. The archetype has few answers to dedicated location removal.

comboPackages.name: Amethyst/Steel Fighter Chain
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Establishes efficient trading board that denies aggro strategies lore-scoring windows. Genie - Magical Researcher steals games if not immediately removed.
comboPackages.counterplay: Play around Strength of a Raging Fire timing by deploying threats one at a time. Remove Genie - Magical Researcher immediately.

comboPackages.name: Enigmatic Inkcaster Flood
comboPackages.whyItMatters: Triggers Enigmatic Inkcaster twice per turn with a flood of 1-costs for explosive lore generation.
comboPackages.counterplay: Remove Enigmatic Inkcaster immediately — the deck has no backup win condition without it.

infinity.note: Infinity format featured as main event at upcoming DLC Indianapolis and DLC Dortmund. Hiram Flaversham - Toymaker recently banned affects Infinity builds.

topDecks.name: Amber/Emerald Dogs
topDecks.description: Same dominant threat as Core Constructed but with access to all previous Amber/Emerald tools from sets 1-10.
topDecks.gameplan: Same as Core Constructed — flood cheaply, use Grandmother Willow and Under the Sea to close.
strengths: Same dominance as Core Constructed but wider card pool
weaknesses: Infinity counter-decks can run older removal suites
topDecks.mulligan: Same as Core Constructed Dogs — keep Grandmother Willow and cheap dogs.

topDecks.name: Amethyst/Sapphire Control
topDecks.description: The most powerful deck in the game in a vacuum. Access to full Whispers/Winterspell card pool.
keyCards: Demona - Scourge of the Wyvern Clan
topDecks.gameplan: Ramp → card advantage → finishers. Standard Amethyst/Sapphire plan with deeper card pool.
weaknesses: Dogs still a concern in Infinity
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Tipo or Sail the Azurite Sea.

topDecks.name: Amber/Steel
topDecks.description: Lilo - Bundled Up has won an Infinity local tournament. Akood Et Emuti and Angel - Experiment 624 are as powerful here as in Core Constructed.
topDecks.gameplan: Same as Core Constructed Amber/Steel — accelerate into Angel or Stitch, outpace opponent.
weaknesses: Infinity field has wider access to answers
topDecks.mulligan: Keep Angel - Siren Singer and Akood Et Emuti.
